robot:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel art robot animation sprite atlas for a cozy automated farming game.
Create ONE transparent PNG atlas, exactly 1024 x 1024, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256 x 256 cells, no gutters. Each cell contains one complete small robot animation frame centered at x=128 and ground baseline y=210 relative to cell. Transparent background. No text, no grid lines, no labels.
Character invariant: cute hovering farming robot, cream rounded-square shell, deep teal faceplate, two mint square eyes, tiny brass antenna, teal side arms, single mint hover thruster below body, no legs. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right. Chunky authentic pixel art, hard square pixels, approximately 64x64 logical pixels per cell enlarged 4x nearest neighbor, dark blue-green 1 logical pixel outlines, 3-tone shading, top-left light.
